summary: Macro Bank Inc. on Form 6-K reports that its board resolved to pay a cash dividend totaling AR $147,101,261,954 in three equal monthly instalments, with the first instalment of AR $49,033,753,984.66 (AR $76.6882980676 per share) payable May 19, 2026 to holders of record May 18, 2026. The dividend is an ordinary cash distribution, not a return of capital or special dividend. The company is distributing excess capital to shareholders. The filing is a routine report of a dividend declaration, not a special situation. No buyback, tender, or any other capital return structure is involved.
